dedupe_keys.name: industrial electricity natural gas and water prices in iran 2015 2019

description: This dataset holds the prices that industries in Iran paid for electricity, natural gas and water from 2015 to 2019. The 4TU.ResearchData record says the prices were gathered from the official websites of the ministries and converted to euro using the real exchange rate. It was published in February 2020 by Shiva Noori as a zip file of about 11.6 MB with a readme; DataCite lists PDF, XLSX, image and text media types and Persian (fa) as the language. It is free under CC BY-NC 4.0, so commercial use is not allowed. Coverage is Iran, national tariffs for industrial users. Caveats: the tariff structure (blocks, time of use, sector differences) and the exchange-rate source are not stated on the page read, and some source documents may be in Persian only. For simulation it gives utility cost inputs for industrial production and water-energy trade-off models in Iran, including what tariff changes mean for factory operating costs. Related catalogue records include the industrial energy prices for 48 countries and the product water footprint statistics.
